four_state_carrier.general_spectrum: a-r with multiplicity 2 and a+r with multiplicity 2, r=sqrt(b^2+c^2+d^2)

multiplicity_obstruction.consequence: Every flux-only eigenvalue has multiplicity divisible by m. A rank-one reference state or a 3+1 split cannot be generated by the flux algebra.

six_state_three_multiplicity_test.temptation: interpret the multiplicity-three factor as three generations
six_state_three_multiplicity_test.failure: The flux acts trivially on that factor. All mass hierarchy and mixing operators then lie in the unrestricted M3 commutant and are not selected by topology.

commutant_breaking_cost.four_state_case: Splitting the two equivalent projective copies requires a non-scalar Hermitian element of M2 in the commutant. Its direction is continuously rotatable by U(2).
commutant_breaking_cost.six_state_case: Producing realistic three-family masses requires a general Hermitian M3 commutant element; producing CKM requires two noncommuting such elements.
commutant_breaking_cost.trace_result: The normalized trace fixes norms after these elements are chosen but does not select their directions or relative coefficients.

scientific_verdict.minimal_four_state_flux: Cannot yield one heavy reference plus three light families because all flux-only spectral multiplicities are even.
scientific_verdict.six_state_flux_times_three: Restores the number three only as an unexplained multiplicity and leaves the entire flavor problem in an arbitrary M3 commutant.
scientific_verdict.no_go: Changing from the 1+3 menu to the minimal projective carrier does not solve generation counting and mixing simultaneously.
scientific_verdict.reopening_condition: An additional discrete symmetry must act irreducibly on the multiplicity space and fix two noncommuting flavor operators with no continuous coefficients.
